chessNotices.title: Notifications
chessNotices.empty: No chess invitations or replies yet.
chessNotices.sent: Invitation saved. The recipient can accept it through notifications.
chessNotices.demoHint: DEMO · Invitations and replies are shared only between fictional profiles in this browser. Switch the demo profile to try it. Real invitations require signing in.
chessNotices.liveHint: Your saved chess invitations and replies appear here. While the website is open and visible, server data refreshes regularly; returning reloads it.
chessNotices.emailMissing: Invitation emails and alerts while the website is closed are not configured yet. The invitation remains saved on the website and appears when you next open it.
chessNotices.localRead: With this server version, read status is remembered only on this device. Invitations themselves remain saved on the server.

kinds.sent: Your invitation is awaiting a reply
kinds.accepted: Invitation accepted – the game is ready

leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
leaderboard.empty: No results from participating demo profiles yet.
leaderboard.ties: Equal scores share a rank (1, 1, 3). Stable profile IDs determine the display order within a tie and provide no advantage.
leaderboard.demo: DEMO · All leaderboard values come from local games by fictional profiles in this browser. This is not a real global online leaderboard.
leaderboard.accountChess: Your personal chess games come from your server-validated account data. Practice games on the same device count separately and earn no leaderboard points.
leaderboard.accountLocal: These single-player results belong only to your account on this device. They are not server-verified and are not submitted to a real global leaderboard.
leaderboard.backendMissing: The shared leaderboard is not connected yet. Results must be securely validated and stored together; participation remains voluntary. You can find your existing results under Personal.
leaderboard.schoolHint: School assignment follows each profile. School membership is self-reported and unverified.
leaderboard.noSchool: Select a school in your profile to use a school leaderboard. No school is assumed automatically.
leaderboard.shareHint: Applies only to this game. Other local demo profiles see your display name and points. Off by default; turning it off removes your leaderboard entry. Personal results are kept.
leaderboard.practiceHint: Wins, losses, draws and completed ranked games cover matches against another profile. Same-device practice games remain separate. Local demo challenges are not verified online wins.
leaderboard.legacy: Previous device record without a profile assignment (excluded from rankings)
leaderboard.failed: Local saving is unavailable or failed. Unsaved results will be lost when leaving this page. Existing corrupt storage files are not overwritten.

rules.chess: Each completed win against another profile earns one point. Losses and draws earn zero. Ongoing, invalid and local practice games are excluded from the win ranking.
rules.memory: Each game with all six pairs found earns exactly one point. Completion time does not affect the rank.
rules.flight: Only your highest score from one finished run counts. Runs are not added together. Speed rises gradually to a fixed upper limit; restarting resets it.
rules.runner: Only your best score from one finished run counts. Runs are not added together. The existing jump mechanics are preserved.

games.title: Games
games.description: A short break or a shared match – with voluntary, clearly labeled demo leaderboards.
games.runnerHint: Jump over obstacles. Tap, press Space or Arrow Up.
games.flightHint: Keep the paper plane flying. Tap or press Space for lift.
games.memoryHint: Reveal two matching symbols. No time limit.
games.localHint: Solo games run on this device. Best scores are only stored locally and may be lost.
games.hotseatHint: Take turns on the same device. This is not an online match.
games.challengeHint: In the guest demo, challenges are shared only between demo profiles in this browser. Nothing reaches other devices.
games.noGames: No match yet. Start locally or challenge someone.
games.selectHint: Select your piece, then a highlighted destination.
games.saveFailed: The move could not be saved. Reload the position and try again.
games.noPlayers: No shared players yet. In the demo, you can enable sharing for the other profile.
games.connectionHint: Online moves are checked by the server. After disconnection the stored position is reloaded. There is no chess clock.
games.offlineBuildHint: Offline preparation is available in production mode. You can already play the solo games here.
games.offlineHint: Stores app and game files on this device. Accounts and online communication still need internet.
games.offlineReady: Game files are saved on this device. Offline use has not been interactively verified here yet.
games.offlineFailed: Offline files could not be fully saved. Try again with an internet connection.

real.liveHint: You are using your verified account. Changes are saved on the shared server.
real.connectionError: The server is currently unreachable. The last loaded data stays visible; changes are not reported as saved.
real.noSchool: Select your school in your profile
real.mailSent: If the request is eligible, a confirmation email was sent. Open its link, then sign in.
real.eventAccountRequired: You need an account to propose an event. You can explore existing events in the guest demo.
real.authHint: Do not put private contact information in your display name. Confirm your email address after registering.
real.signInHint: Sign in with your registered email address and password. Signing in does not send an email.
real.resendHint: Request a new confirmation link here if your account is not confirmed yet. If your email is already confirmed, use “Sign in” with your password.
real.passwordHint: At least twelve characters. The app does not store your password.
real.invalidForm: Enter a valid email, display name and password with at least twelve characters.
real.requestFailed: The request failed. Check your input or try again later.
real.formHint: Your contribution is saved on the server for other authorized members.
real.privacyHint: Do not publish private contact information. Your school is initially self-reported, not a verified school membership.
real.registrationHint: Your registration is saved. Registration does not prove actual attendance.
real.registrationSaved: Registration saved. Find the event in My area → Activities.
real.projectHint: Interest is not membership. You become a project member only after your request is accepted.
real.requestSaved: Your request was delivered to the project owner.
real.tutoringHint: Non-commercial learning support. No payments or public contact information.
real.contactHint: This request draft is saved privately for you and is not sent. Use supervised groups to communicate.
real.messageHint: Posts are visible to members of this group and responsible moderators. The view updates automatically.
real.shareHint: Your short profile appears in the directory only if you opt in. You can withdraw sharing.
real.reported: Report saved. Platform moderators can review it in the moderation area.
real.groupsHint: Project groups follow accepted project memberships. You can voluntarily join topic rooms.
real.settingsIntro: Adjust your profile, interests and language.
real.noAttendance: No confirmed attendance records for this account yet.
real.eventNotOpen: You can express interest in this proposal. Registration opens after approval.
real.createEventHint: Moderators must review a proposal before registration opens.
real.eventError: Enter a title, description, school and future date.
real.groupRequired: Join this group first to read and write posts.
real.blockHint: Blocked profiles cannot invite you to games. Their posts and listings are hidden from you.
real.moderationRequired: Real group posts require configured moderation.

errors.over_email_send_rate_limit: Email delivery is temporarily limited. Please try again later. If your email is already confirmed, you can sign in directly with your password.
errors.confirmation-link-expired: This confirmation link has expired or has already been used. If your email is confirmed, sign in. Otherwise, request a new link using “Resend confirmation”.
errors.confirmation-link-invalid: This confirmation link is invalid. If your email is confirmed, sign in. Otherwise, request a new link using “Resend confirmation”.
errors.conflict: The data changed in the meantime. Please reload.
errors.invalid-input: Complete your profile and check your input.
errors.private-contact: Do not publish private contact information or links in posts.
errors.rate-limit: Too many requests. Please wait a moment.
errors.not-allowed: This action is not allowed right now.

real.noActivity: No community posts of your own yet.

awards.title: Recognition
awards.hint: Optional, with no leaderboard. Recognition requires a confirmed actual contribution.
awards.empty: No confirmed recognition for this profile yet.
awards.demoHint: The guest demo does not invent real contributions or awards.
